in_sanskrit.name: Shiva-Sankara
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who accompanies Lord Shiva

in_marathi.name: Sivasankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva's Grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sivasankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sivasankar is a compound of two words. Siva refers to Lord Shiva, the supreme deity in Hinduism. Sankar means the one who bestows grace. Thus, Sivasankar means Lord Shiva's Grace.
